scenarios.title: Wall penetration tolerance test
scenarios.scenario: When can a tolerance be made and which cases are acceptable for wall penetrations.
scenarios.solution:
1. Check the inner sleeve is flush with the wall.
2. Apply silicone sealant on the outer side only.
3. Verify no visible gaps remain after curing.

en.title: Wall penetration tolerance test
en.scenario: When can a tolerance be made and which cases are acceptable for wall penetrations.
en.solution:
1. Check the inner sleeve is flush with the wall.
2. Apply silicone sealant on the outer side only.
3. Verify no visible gaps remain after curing.
en.acceptance:
1. No visible gap larger than 2mm.
2. Sealant fully cured before inspection.
